title: NodeBB Patches Eight AI-Found Flaws Exposing Admin Access and Private Chats

sections.impact:

sections.mitigation: NodeBB has fixed them all, and administrators should be on 4.14.2.

email_summary: Eight security flaws in NodeBB went public on Wednesday, along with the code to exploit them. Severity is rated high.
